note: Calibration series O (laps/calibrate-80/design.md, tool E): laps/calibrate-80/tools.md describes what --precheck checks. A merged request (stage L1 / L2) names its parts; its rules are "<part>/<rule>": every rule of each part, plus the rules that tie the parts together, each with the head of the part whose behaviour it changes. Its pairs hold every pair of each part (with the heads) and the cross pairs (two rules with different heads), each with the reason. The parts are copied as they are from laps/lap-10, lap-11 and lap-12 rules.json. ui / service list the merged rules of that kind and are not counted.
